versions.content: The value of the EcucContainerDef . multiplicity- ConfigClass attribute in the VSMD in case it is defined in the StMD If the multiplicityConfigClass attribute of an EcucContainerDef is de- fined in the StMD and its upperMultiplicity is greater than lowerMulti- plicity , multiplicityConfigClass . configClass for each multiplic- ityConfigClass . configVariant in the VSMD shall be the same or higher (where PreCompile is considered to be the lowest and PostBuild the highest) as in the StMD with respect to the selected subset defined by the actually imple- mented supportedConfigVariant of the corresponding EcucModuleDef .
